title: Code and data for: Anchoring Options to an Incomplete Forward Curve: Identification and Out-of-Sample Evidence from Turkish Electricity
description: Forward-centred option valuation for the Turkish day-ahead electricity market: equality-constrained hourly forward curve from EPIAS VEP monthly baseload quotes, two-regime Markov-switching residual with time-varying transition probabilities, PDE and Monte Carlo pricing, independent re-estimation of the residual process, and out-of-sample evaluation on 2026 data. Code is released under the MIT licence; the manuscript under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; documentation and derived data under CC BY 4.0; raw EPIAS data remain under the EPIAS Seffaflik Platformu terms of use.
